summary.title: RAUGSTAD AS

narrative.text: RAUGSTAD AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Annen teknisk konsulentvirksomhet", registered 2007-06-25.

Registered activity: Kjøp og salg av verdipapirer, salg av konsulenttjenester, erverve og eie og utvikle eiendommer, samt hva hermed står i forbindelse, herunder delta i selskaper med lignende virksomhet.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 1.1 million and an annual result of NOK -702,808.
Registered leadership: Odin Traa Raugstad (Daglig leder); John Frode Raugstad (Styrets leder).
Head office in Sandnes, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
